# CustoVox.ai

> CustoVox.ai is a Voice of Customer analysis service by Corpstxt (SASU, Wambrechies, France). It uses AI and NLP to analyze calls, customer reviews, support tickets and emails, and detects emotions, escalation risks, churn risk, pain points, unmet needs and product gaps — in any language, without a data team. Plans start at €49/month (excl. VAT); a free case study (analysis of 100 reviews or tickets, results within 48 hours) is available.

Key facts:
- Analysis modules: TextIQ (text), VoiceIQ (voice), VisualIQ (images), PredictIQ (prediction), SearchIQ (search).
- Native languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese.
- Analyses run with CustoVox.ai's own models and scripts; customer data is hosted in France and never used to train models.
- Free case study files are deleted within 30 days after delivery; a GDPR Article 28 data processing agreement is available.
- Open-source MCP servers for customer-experience analytics are published on GitHub and PyPI (custovox-sentiment).
